observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check before emitting a snapshot, skipping the emit if the first snapshot has not yet been delivered. This prevents duplicate snapshot delivery when a subscriber joins during the bootstrap phase.
observations.posthog_connection: CloudTaskEngine's emitCurrentSnapshot is guarded by existing.hasEmittedSnapshot, avoiding redundant transcript fetches and serialized emits for subscribers that joined while the watcher was still bootstrapping.

observations.behavior: Adds a new shared subscription layer, SharedCloudTaskSubscriptions, which fans out a single host subscription to multiple local subscribers. It also adds an unwatch mechanism that removes the host subscription when the last subscriber leaves.
observations.posthog_connection: SharedCloudTaskSubscriptions maintains a single transport subscription per task run, sharing updates and start signals among subscribers, while unwatching the transport only when the last subscriber leaves.
